settings.heading: Delivery, pickup, assembly and returns.
settings.lead: Short answers for each step, from checkout to your shop floor.

settings.title: Local delivery
settings.text: We deliver in the Lower Mainland, including Vancouver, Richmond and the Tri-Cities, for a flat rate of $100. Our team brings your new workbench or cabinet to your door so it arrives safely and quickly.
settings.points: Flat $100 to Vancouver, Richmond, the Tri-Cities and nearby|Delivered by the TOOSA team|Orders over $3,000 qualify for free shipping

settings.title: Shipping across Canada
settings.text: Outside the Lower Mainland, rates are calculated for every delivery location in Canada and added automatically at checkout once you enter your postal code.
settings.points: Larger units ship on a pallet|Tell us if your address needs a lift-gate or has limited truck access|Free shipping on orders over $3,000
settings.note: Need a quote for a business order or a tricky location? We'll price it for you.

settings.title: Pickup
settings.text: Free local curbside pickup is available from our Richmond, BC warehouse at Unit 142 – 11566 Eburne Way. Place your order online, then schedule your pickup time with us.
settings.points: Richmond, BC warehouse, curbside|Order online, then book a pickup time with us|In Alberta, collect through our Calgary distributor, My Tool Shop

settings.title: Assembly & installation
settings.text: Base units arrive assembled where shipping allows. Add-ons such as hutches, side lockers and pegboards bolt on with basic hand tools, and instructions and hardware are included where applicable.
settings.points: Professional assembly is available on eligible products for an additional charge; ask us when you order|Air compressor: a licensed electrician for the 3-phase connection and a compressed-air installer for piping, dryer and drains
settings.ul_text: The TS-20 compressor is a UL-certified package with a UL-listed inverter

settings.title: Returns & exchanges
settings.text:
We provide free in-person and virtual product demos so you can be sure you're choosing the right TOOSA product for your workspace before you buy. Because of this, we do not offer returns or exchanges after purchase.

We believe in the quality of our workbenches, cabinets and workstands, and we're confident they will meet your needs. Not sure which configuration is right? Book a demo first.

settings.title: Warranty
settings.text: TOOSA products come with a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.
settings.points: Product-specific warranties may vary, particularly for specialised equipment such as air compressors|The exact terms are listed with each product

settings.title: Damaged or incorrect items
settings.text: Inspect your delivery when it arrives. If anything is damaged in transit or not what you ordered, contact us as soon as possible and we'll sort it out.
settings.points: Have your order number handy|Send photos of the damage or the item

settings.heading: Questions about delivery?
settings.lead: Tell us where you are and what you're ordering; we'll confirm the cost and timing before you commit.
